dpi.name: Dorsey Power Index
dpi.note: DPI evaluates individual capability categories. Baseline mean is analytics-only and is not a canonical overall power score.

characters.summary: Tucson-based detective and ASC-altered nocturnal metahuman with desert-specialized movement, enhanced senses, regeneration, burrowing, and self-built venomous projectile nail equipment.
Fully human Chicago vigilante who weaponizes exceptional agility, dirty fighting, close-quarters awareness, improvised tactics, and the environment around him.
Puerto Rican hero who stores his own physical actions at exact positions in space and triggers each stored action one additional time within a 90-second window.
rules: Each stored action can replay once
Only Nico's own personally produced motion can be stored
No clones, homing, teleportation, flight, or unrelated kinetic blasts

characters.summary: Shared heroic identity of twin siblings Micah and Naomi Ellison: an elite human gunfighter and his independently conscious two-dimensional shadow sister.
powers: Naomi controls her own shape, orientation, and movement rather than all darkness
Naomi physically interacts with the world
Naomi independently protects Micah and watches blind angles
Darkness enables concealment and very fast movement
Kincast operates with two independent observers
equipment: Ivory ballistic hand cannon associated with Micah
Black compact ballistic machine pistol associated with Naomi

organizations.name: Los Moralistas
organizations.summary: Fictional cartel with its core in Mexico, meaningful but limited U.S. border presence, and scattered interior logistics. Connected to Gila Monster's ASC alteration as customer, funder, and operator; not established as the inventor of ASC.

The St. Dorsey event that produced exactly 77 Ascendants.
